findings.detail: If an input disappears, becomes unreadable or encounters an I/O error during the final fingerprint read, snapshot() catches the OSError and returns its diagnostic in contents. This caller discards contents and reports only "inputs changed during run"; verified() similarly reports "stale input fingerprints". Publication fails safely, but neither message identifies the affected file or preserves the underlying filesystem failure.
findings.fix: Retain both snapshot return values in run() and verified(), and surface any null-fingerprint diagnostics before comparing fingerprints. Preserve the affected path and original OSError in the failed JSON or render refusal.
findings.title: Uncited: Fingerprint rechecks discard filesystem failure diagnostics.

strengths: Timeouts retain captured diagnostics, and timed-out, unreaped or truncated steps cannot count as success.
Restoration failures preserve the preceding failure cause.
Rendering independently verifies step evidence before publishing records.
summary: Reviewed all 24 membership paths and their committed changes for error handling. Found one diagnostic gap; no Important or Critical defects were identified. Review was static, with tests unrun under the read-only constraint.
